ἐπιτολμάω.definition: submit or endure to do; dare, venture, abs., Ph.1.594 : c. inf., ib.671, al., Gal.12.710 : c. dat., venture upon, Plu.Phil.10, Ant.69; mount it, Philostr.Im.1.11; Ruf.Ren.Ves.2.36, Ael.NA7.19, Anon. ap. Suid.s.v

ἐπίτονος.definition: on the stretch, strained, intense; a rope for stretching or tightening, back-stay of a mast , Od.12.423

ἐπιτοξάζομαι.definition: shoot at, Il.3.79; also in late Prose, Luc.Cal.12, D.C.74.6: abs., Agath.3.22

ἐπιτρέπω.definition: Ion. Hdt.3.81 : fut; to overturn upon, Luc.Lex.8

ἐπιτρέχω.definition: fut. X.Cyn.9.6, D.17.19 : aor. 2 Il.4.524, al. : pf. X.Oec.15.6; poet. Od., etc. :-Pass., pf. X.Oec.15.1 : -run upon or at, mostly for the purpose of attack, abs., Il.4.524, cf. 18.527; of dogs, Od.14.30; make an assa…

ἐπιτυχής.definition: hitting the mark; Pass., easy to hit, App.Syr.35

ἐπιφέρω.definition: fut. aor. 1 aor.2; inflict, J.AJ2.14.2, PTeb.331.10 ; vent, Ep.Rom.3.5

ἐπιφθονέω.definition: grudge any one's doing a thing; bear hate or a grudge against, Hdt.9.79, PMasp.154.9 :—Pass., to be regarded with jealous hate, D.H.9.43

ἐπιφλέγω.definition: heat, inflame, Aët.15.20: metaph., inflame, excite, A.Pers.395; Tim.Pers.222; Plu.Cat.Ma.1; with love, Id.2.767f: —Pass., Arist.Phgn.812a27, Ael.NA15.9

ἐπιφόρημα.definition: in pl., dishes served up besides; offering at the grave, Iamb.VP27.122

ἐπιφράζω.definition: say besides, Hdt.1.179 (Bekk. for; elsewh. only in Med., mostly aor. 1, and Pass. aor. 1

ἐπίφρασις.definition: Rhet., specific mention of an individual, a form of pleonasm, Phoeb.Fig.1.3

ἐπιφωνέω.definition: mention by name, tell of; add a title, Ph.1.337

ἐπιφώσκω.definition: = grow towards daylight, dawn; trans., let shine forth, Poet.de herb.24

ἐπιχειρέω.definition: put one's hand to; put one's hand to a work, set to work at, attempt, Hdt.2.158; attempt an escape, Id.6.70; Id.7.43, cf. E.Ba.819; Hdt.3.61; Id.5.46; Id.9.27; Pl.Phdr.279a, Grg.521d, etc.; X.Mem.2.3.5, cf. Isoc.5.41,…

ἐπιχέω.definition: fut. 2sg. Ar.Pax169: aor. 1; pour in, Pl.R.407d; Diph.107 codd. Stob.; fill a cup, AP12.168 . B. Med., pour or throw over oneself, Od.5.487; Antyll. ap. Orib.10.8.4; she threw her arms round the boy, A.R.1.268; but fo…

ἐπίχολος.definition: full of bile, bilious; Act., producing bile, Hdt.4.58

ἐπιχορεύω.definition: dance to or in honour of a thing; add a chorus or choral song, Philostr.VA5.14

ἐπιχράω.definition: touch on the surface, graze, c. gen., .. A.R.2.283: c. acc., Q.S.11.480

ἐπιχρίω.definition: anoint, besmear, (sc; plaster over, with a thing, Luc.Hist.Conscr.62

ἐπίχρυσος.definition: overlaid or plated with gold; rich, prob. for Hld.2.8

ἐπιψαίρω.definition: skim the surface of a thing, Opp.H.4.512

ἐπιψαύω.definition: Dor. fut. Archim.Con.Sph.30:—touch on; Geom., tangent, Archim.Sph.Cyl.1.12, etc

ἐπογμεύω.definition: trace a furrow: hence, metaph of dancing, Tryph.354

ἐποικέω.definition: go as settler or colonist to a place, settle; to be settled near or with hostile views against, Th.6.86:—Pass., Decelea was occupied as the seat of offensive operations against their country, Id.7.27

ἐποίχομαι.definition: go towards, approach; approach with hostile purpose, attack, c. acc., Il.5.330, cf. 10.487

ἐποκλάζω.definition: cower with bent knees upon, Hld.4.17

ἐπομβρία.definition: heavy rain, abundance of rain; the Deluge, J.AJ1.2.3, al

ἐπόμνυμι.definition: c. acc. cogn., Il.10.332; .. whosoever swear a false oath by it [the Styx], Hes.Th.793, cf. Emp.115.4; also swear an oath at his dictation, Plu.Cic.23:—Med., Stud.Pal.20.122.16 , etc

ἐποπίζομαι.definition: only pres. and impf., regard with awe, reverence, Od.5.146, cf. h.Ven.290, Thgn.1297

ἐποποιία.definition: Ep. epic poetry or an epic; divination by means of Homeric verses, PMag. Berol.1.328

ἐποπτάω.definition: roast besides or after, Od.12.363, Diph.Siph; Pass., to be burnt, Paul.Aeg.3.67

ἐποπτεύω.definition: overlook, watch, of an overseer; visit, punish, A.Eu.220

ἐπόπτης.definition: overseer, watcher, esp. of; simply, spectator, A.Pr.301

ἔποπτις.definition: fem. of v.l. in Corn.ND34; title of a book by Soranus, Plin.HN Praef.33

ἐπορέγω.definition: hold out to, give yet more; metaph., Procl.Inst.131

ἐπόρνυμι.definition: and aor. 1 poet. Verb, stir; Pass., with pf. later 3sg. Pancr.Oxy.1085.15: 3sg.Ep.aor. 2 Pass. against, fly upon one, c. dat., Il.21.324: abs., 23.689, cf. 759, Euph.23: c. acc. cogn., A.Supp.187; of things, c. inf., …

ἐπορούω.definition: Ep. Verb, spring at, in hostile sense; sprang to his side, 5.793; came suddenly upon him, Od.23.343

ἐποτρύνω.definition: stir up, excite, urge on, abs; c.acc. rei, stirs up war against us, 22.152; also .. Th.7.25; .. send urgent messages to the cities of the C., Od.24.355; gave the signal for engagement to the men-atarms, Th.6.69:—Med.,…

ἐπουριάζω.definition: of a fair wind, waft onwards; metaph., spreading out his ears to catch gossip, v.l. in Ph.2.4

ἐποχέομαι.definition: float upon, Placit.3.15.8; float on the surface, Gal.7.604, Aët.5.137

ἐποχεύω.definition: of the male animal, spring upon, cover, Arist.GA741a31:—Med., couple with, Emp.90

ἐπόψημα.definition: that which is eaten with bread, IG7.2712.81

ἑπταετής.definition: = seven years old, v.l. in; parox. of seven years: neut. as Adv., for seven years, Od.3.304,7.259

ἑπτάθεος.definition: having seven gods, gloss on the name Peripl.M.Eux.p.415 M

ἑπτάμυχος.definition: with seven recesses, Call.Del.65: title of work by Pherecyd.Syr

ἔπω.definition: say, call, name, Nic.Al.429, cf. 490, Th.508

ἕπω.definition: to be about, busy oneself with, Il.6.321: elsewh. with Preps., in tmesi, cf

ἐπῳάζω.definition: sit or brood upon eggs, mostly of birds; trans., hatch, incubate young birds by artificial heat, D.S.1.74

ἐπωθέω.definition: push on, impel, h.Ap.382; Pass., of tumours, to be brought to a head, v.l. in Hp.Epid.7.105

ἐπωκής.definition: somewhat sharp or acid, in Comp., Hp.Int.21 , cf.22

ἐπωμίς.definition: the point of the shoulder; Poet., shoulder, Achae.4, Call.Del.143, AP9.588

ἐπώμοτος.definition: on oath, sworn, S.Tr.427; cf; Pass., witness of oaths, like ib.1188

ἔραμαι.definition: love, c. gen. pers., prop. of the sexual passion, as always in Hom.; mostly of the man, Il.3.446, cf. 16.182, 20.223, etc.; E.Med.491; Hdt.1.8; but of the woman, .. Od.11.238: c. acc. cogn., E.Med.697

ἐρατίζω.definition: Ep.form of used by Hom. always in; love, Call.Fr.20

ἐράω.definition: used in Act. only in pres. and impf. (which; without sexual reference, love warmly, opp. Pl.Ly.222a:—and in Pass., X.Hier.11.11, cf. Plu.Brut.29; Arist.Metaph.1072b3

ἐργάζομαι.definition: Il.18.469, etc., Cret; trans., work at, make, of Athena, Od.20.72, cf. 22.422; Pi.N.5.1,I.2.46; SIG34 ; Ar.Nu.880; Th.2.76; Pl.Cra.431c, X.Mem.2.6.6, Pl.Men.91d; of bees, Arist.HA627a6,30; Sor.Vit. Hippocr.11; make so…

ἐργατίνης.definition: = esp. husbandman; c. gen., making a thing or practising an art, AP5.239 ; ib.274

ἐργομωκεύω.definition: flatter, wheedle, Gloss.:—Med., = assentior, ancillor, prob. in Dosith.p.430 K.:—hence Gloss

ἔργω.definition: Ep. and Ion., and Ep. for Att. (or; shut in, shut up, Il.21.282; pen, Od.10.283; 9.221; 14.411; encloses, Il.2.845 ; drove them to the ships and shut them up there, Il.16.395, cf.12.219, Th.1.106; shut up, Thgn.710; e…

ἐρεείνω.definition: ask, inquire : c. acc. pers., ask of; visit a place, D.P.713

ἐρεθίζω.definition: Ep.inf. Il.4.5: impf; abs., to be quarrelsome or perverse, Ph.1.359

ἐρέθω.definition: Mosch.3.84, Theoc. , Ep; explore, search, v.l. for in Nic.Th.143

ἐρείδω.definition: Ep. impf. Il.13.131: fut; prop up, support, stay, of close ranks of men- at-arms, Il.13.131; Tyrt.11.31; E.Rh.487; A.Pr.352

ἐρείπω.definition: intr., aor. 2 Ep. fall down, Il.5.47, etc.; fell on his knee, ib.68; ib.75, 11.743; oftrees, 21.243: hence, of a warrior, 13.389; Theoc.13.50: metaph., her heart sank with terror, Simon.37.3; where this tense is apptl…

ἔρεισις.definition: propping up, shoring up; resting, supporting, Aristeas69

ἐρέπτομαι.definition: feed on, c. acc., only in pres. part., mostly of granivorous animals, Il.2.776,5.196, Od.19.553, al.; of men, 9.97, AP9.618; ib.7.20; of fish, feeding on the fat of a carcase, Il.21.204.—Ep. Verb, used burlesquely by …

ἐρέσσω.definition: Plu.2.1128c, Pomp.73, Cic.47, rarely; trans., speed by rowing: metaph., .. .. ply with your hands the measured stroke of lamentation, A.Th.855 :—Pass., ib.422, cf. Supp.723, A.R.1.633; of birds, A.Ag.52

ἐρετμόω.definition: furnish with oars, set to row, E.Med.4; pursue a course, ib.33.191, al

ἐρεύγομαι.definition: also , fut. Hp.Mul.1.41: aor.1 Procop.Goth.2.4: aor. 2 Arist.Pr.895b22, Nic.Al.111:-belch out, disgorge, c. acc., Il.16.162; Nic.Th.232: abs., belch, Od.9.374, cf. Hp.Morb.2.69, Arist.Pr.895b12. 2. metaph., of volcano…

ἐρεύθω.definition: aor. 1 inf. Il. :—make red; intr. in Act., B.12.152; Hp.Morb.4.38

ἔρευνα.definition: inquiry, search, search for; exploratory operation, Herod.Med. ap. Orib.50.46.2

ἐρευνάω.definition: also GDI5075.35 , and; search, explore a place, Sor.Vit.Hippocr.3; Pi.N.3.24; Theoc.25.221; Ael.Tact.17: abs., thou wilt find by searching, Pi.O.13.113, cf. S.Ant.268; Antipho5.29

ἐρέφω.definition: cover with a crown, crown, Pi.O.13.32; S.OC473:—Med., crown oneself, E.Ba.323; B.8.24; one's forehead, A.R.2.159:—Pass., B.12.70

ἐρέχθω.definition: rend, break, Od.5.83:—Pass., of a ship, buffeted by the winds, Il.23.317: metaph., h.Ap.358; Procl.H.7.38

ἐρέω.definition: Ep. Verb, = ask; c. acc. rei, search, explore, Nic.Th.143 . -, cf. perh. metri gr. for pres. subj. of non-thematic stem.)

ἐρητύω.definition: Dor. impf. Il.18.503, Ion. A.R.1.1301, Q.S.11.341: fut. A.R.1.296, S.Ph.1416 : aor. 1 opt. Il.1.192, imper. E.Ph.1260, Iterat. Il.2.189, 11.567, Theoc.25.75:-Pass. . before a vowel, unless it be a long syll., as Il.8.…

ἐριαύχην.definition: with arched neck, opp. Il.10.305, al., never in Od

ἐριαχθής.definition: laden with wool, woolly, or heavy-laden, Max.520

ἐριδαίνω.definition: impf. Babr.68.3: Ep. aor. I A.R.1.89: —Med., Q.S.5.105: Ep. aor. I inf. Il.23.792 ; elsewh. Hom. uses only pres.: :—wrangle, quarrel, Od.21.310; Il.2.342; Od.18.403; Il.1.574; we strive for her excellence, Od.2.206: c…

ἐριδμαίνω.definition: = to provoke to strife, irritate; intr., = contend, A.R.3.94; of friendly rivalry, Mosch.2.69; APl.4.297; Nic.Al.407; Nonn.D.37.490: c. inf., Theoc.12.31

ἐρίζω.definition: Dor. 3pl. Pi.N.5.39; Ep. inf; Pass., there are contests in fleetness of foot, Pi.O.1.95

ἐρίθαλλος.definition: growing luxuriantly, flourishing, of plants and trees, Simon.54

ἐρικύμων.definition: big with young, A.Ag.119 codd. recc

ἐριοφόρος.definition: wool-bearing, cotton-tree, Gossypium arboreum, Thphr.HP4.7.7 ; Pancratium maritimum, ib.7.13.8

ἐρίφλοιος.definition: with thick bark, Pergamene wood, Agathocl. ap. Eust.994.42

ἑρκίτης.definition: name for a farm-slave, Amer. ap. Ath.6.267c

ἕρμαιον.definition: prop. gift of Hermes, i.e. unexpected; barrow, tomb, Papers of Amer. School 3 Nos.501, 585

ἔρομαι.definition: c. acc. objecti, learn by inquiry, Od.6.298; ask after or for, Il.6.239; 24.390; Od.16.402

ἑρπύζω.definition: impf. Q.S.13.93: pres. only in Hom.: aor. 1 in Att. :—creep, crawl, in Hom. always of persons weighed down by age or deep distress, Od.1.193; 13.220, cf. Il.23.225, A.R.4.1289; of quadrupeds and children, Nic.Al.542; …

ἕρπω.definition: impf. Od.12.395 codd., E.Cyc.423, etc; simply, go, come, in Dor. dialects, where the aor. is etc., IG4.951.86 , cf. GDI 5040.39 , BMus.Inscr.968 A 6 , etc., cf. also freq. in Trag., A.Pr.810, etc. ; S.OC1643; E.HF1154…

ἔρρω.definition: go or come to one's own harm, Il.8.239,9.364; h.Merc. l.c.; A.Eu.884; he went with a murrain to Polybus, Ar.Ra.1192, cf.Lys.336

ἐρύθημα.definition: redness or flush upon the skin; concrete, scarlet garments, LXXIs.63.1

ἐρυκανάω.definition: poet. for restrain, withhold, Od.1.199: c.inf., from doing, Q.S.12.205: also Ep. impf. Od.10.429, cf. Orph.A.647

ἐρύω.definition: Il.4.467, al., Ion. Dor. (v; simply, draw, pull, 16.863; Od.10.303; Il.8.21; Od.22.176; .. drew it over his head, 8.85; pulling or plucking him by.., Il.22.493; drawing the bowstring at him, 15.464; Hdt.3.30,4.10; dra…

ἔρχομαι.definition: Il.13.256, etc. (Act. as barbarism; start, set out, .. when I was setting out, Il.5.198, cf. 150; a ship was just starting, Od.14.334; Pi.P.1.34

ἐρῶ.definition: I will say or speak, c. acc. rei et dat. pers., Il.1.297: abs., he will say nothing against it, 9.56; among you, ib.528, cf. Od.16.378: freq. in Att., Pl.R.520a , 595b, Tht.179a ; Id.Phlb.29d, etc. : c. acc. pers., sp…

ἐρωέω.definition: Ep.Verb, rush, rush forth, Il.1.303, Od.16.441; of horses, they started back, Il.23.433; escape harm, Nic.Th.117. 2. c. gen. rei, draw back or rest from, Il.13.776, cf. 17.422; 14.101; h.Cer.301; Epic. in Arch.Pap. 7.…

ἐρωή.definition: Ep.Noun , quick motion; impulse, desire, ib.10.112, cf. Procl.H.3.10; Opp.C.3.175

ἐρωμανής.definition: maddened by love; exciting mad love, Orph.H.55.14

ἐρωτάω.definition: Ep. and Ion. contr. in Hom. and best; ask about a thing, A.Pr.228, Pl.R.508a; Id.Tht.185c; to ask a question, Id.R.487e; .. putting the question, whether.., Th.1.5:—Pass., to answer the question, Th.3.61, X.Mem.4.2.23…

ἐρώτημα.definition: that which is asked, question; in Stoic terminology, a question requiring the answer 'Yes' or 'No', opp. Chrysipp.Stoic.2.61

ἐρωτίς.definition: loved one, darling, Theoc.4.59; as Adj., islands of love, AP7.628

ἐσθίω.definition: metaph., the fire devours all, Il.23.182; of an eating sore, A.Fr.253:—Pass., decayed teeth, Thphr.Char.19.3; eroded parts of the bowel, Hp.Epid.4.20

ἔσθω.definition: Ep. inf. Od.7.220: impf. 6.249, MatroConv.115:—poet. form of eat, Od.5.197, cf. 7.220; i.e. eat up chattel and cattle, i.e. all one has, 2.75; of worms or animals, feed on, devour, Il.24.415, Od.13.409: also in Trag.,…

ἑστιάτωρ.definition: one who gives a banquet, host; at Athens, the citizen on whom the liturgy of fell, D.20.21,39.7

ἑστιουχέω.definition: preside over the home or state, Charond. ap. Stob.4.2.24

ἔσφλασις.definition: contused fracture of the skull with depression, Hp.VC6

ἐσφλάω.definition: in Pass., to be so fractured, ibid

ἐσχαρόω.definition: form an eschar, of ointments; ulcerate, Sor.2.12: abs., to be caustic, Dsc.5.75

ἐσχατάω.definition: to be at the edge, Hom. always in Ep. part., straying about the edge of the camp, Il.10.206; lying on the border, 2.508, 616; the extreme west, Call.Del.174, cf. Theoc.7.77; sinciput, Arat.207: with a Verb, at last, M…

ἐσχατεύω.definition: to be at the end; to be the lowest or meanest, Phld.Rh.2.54S

ἐτάζω.definition: aor. 1 , examine, test, mostly; visit, try, afflict, ib.Ge.12.17. as fr

ἑταιρίζω.definition: to be or comrade to any one, c; trans. in Med., associate with oneself, choose for one's comrade, Il.13.456, cf. Call.Dian.206, Naumach. ap. Stob.4.23.7

ἑτερόζυξ.definition: yoked singly, without its; = foreg. II, Nonn.D.5.148

ἑτερόθροος.definition: speaking different tongues; sounding different from before, ib.9.256, al

ἑτερόχρως.definition: sleep with one of different sex, Luc.Am.42

ἑτοιμάζω.definition: pf. Plb.3.72.6: pf. Pass; Med., cause to be prepared, Il.10.571; Od.13.184, cf. Hdt.8.24; Inscr.Prien.55.34

εὐάγεια.definition: brightness, clearness, alertness, Iamb.VP24.107: pl., ib.17.74: prob. cj. ib.3.13

εὐάγωγος.definition: easily led, ductile; easily purged, Gal.15.78

ἐπιλέανσις.definition: chewing small, rumination, ib.254: metaph., ib.115

εἰλιγμός.definition: Mnesith. ap. Orib.8.38.9, Orph.H.38.12; poet.and Ion. for

ἐπιπορεία.definition: coming on the scene, of marionettes, opp. HeroAut.19.1

εὐύαλος.definition: of good glass, AP11.55, acc. to Planudes

εὐβύριος.definition: = Euph.128; said to be from a Messapian word, EM389.24

ἐπαλθέω.definition: heal, cure, fut. Nic.Al.395: aor. ib.614:—Med., aor. Id.Th.654

ἐλέωτρις.definition: a fish of the Nile, Ath.7.312b

ἐχόντως.definition: Adv. pres. part. of in phrase = , Pl.Lg.686e; Id.Phlb.64a

ἐπανθισμός.definition: efflorescence, scum, Dsc.5.92; name for a vein, Dionys. ap. Ruf.Onom.205

ἐξουδενωτής.definition: one who sets at naught, Phld.Vit.p.42J

ἐπαναστρέφω.definition: intr., turn back upon one, wheel round; Pass., return to the surface, Arist.Fr.335

ἐξαράομαι.definition: utter curses, S.Ant.427; dedicate with solemn prayers, Aeschin.3.116

ἐπιπήδησις.definition: springing upon, assault, Plu.2.916d : metaph., ib.76c, etc.; of the male animal, ib.768e, 1095a

ἐπακτήρ.definition: Ep. word, = hunter, huntsman, Od.19.435; Il.17.135; later, fisherman, A.R.1.625

ἐκπρέπω.definition: to be excellent in a thing, E.Heracl.597

ἐπεισβαίνω.definition: go into upon, X.HG1.1.6; go into the sea so as to board ships, Th.2.90, 4.14

ἐναπερεύγω.definition: vomit forth upon, metaph. of lust, Ph.2.393, cf. 202

ἐκμουσόω.definition: strengthd. for teach fully, E.Ba.825; — Pass., Ael.VH14.34

ἑπτάκτις.definition: with seven rays, of the sun, Jul.Or.5.172d, Procl.in Ti.1.34D

ἐκλακτίζω.definition: kick out, fling out behind; metaph., escape, run away, Men.16; also Procop.Pers.1.24

εὐρυχαίτης.definition: Dor. with wide- streaming hair, of Dionysus, Pi.I.7.4

εὐφιλόπαις.definition: the children's darling, of a lion's whelp, A.Ag.721

ἐπιχαλάω.definition: fut. loosen, slacken; drop in, PHolm.15.39

ἐπιτοκία.definition: compound interest, Ph.2.285 ; dub. cj. in Thphr.Char.10.2

ἐντυλόομαι.definition: Pass., grow hard, of callous lumps, dub. l. for Dsc.2.43

εὐκτήριος.definition: of or for prayer; Subst. oratory, Just.Nov.131.7 Intr., Rev.Bibl.1911.287

ἐκκρίνω.definition: single out, Th.6.96; —Pass; separate, Arist.HA578a11, 572b22 ; hold that the rest are separated out from.., Id.Ph.187a23

ἐπιγνώμων.definition: arbiter, umpire, judge; in pl., inspectors, Lys.7.25 ap.Harp

ἔγκτητος.definition: possessed in a foreign country, LXXLe.14.34, al

εὔκριτος.definition: Medic., having a good crisis, Hp.Aph.1.12; Id.Acut.14. Adv. opp. Pall.in Hp.2.181 D

ἑπτάπυρος.definition: with seven flames or wicks, SIG1106.119

ἐπεισβάτης.definition: additional passenger, supernumerary on board ship, E.Hel.1550

ἐπεμπηδάω.definition: trample upon, Ar.Nu.550; make a second throb, of the pulse, Gal.8.556

εὔσφαιρος.definition: fair and round, of pearls, Tz.H.11.490; ib.7.726

ἐπίτιμος.definition: of a citizen, in possession of his; valuable, Agath.1.8

εὐκαιρία.definition: Ion. good season, opportunity; appropriateness, opp. Pl.Phdr.272a; Plu.2.16b,736f

ἐξοδιάριος.definition: at Rome, actor in the Atellana , Lyd.Mag.1.40

ἐπεσχάριος.definition: Subst. hearth, of the earth, dub. in Epigr.Gr.149

ἐπιπήγνυμι.definition: or make to freeze on the top; Pass., to be fastened on, Heliod. ap. Orib.49.4.39

ἔμφυσις.definition: insertion of a muscle, Gal.UP1.21, Orib.25.31.6

ἐπιψηλαφάω.definition: feel by passing the hand over the surface, Pl.R.360a; feel for it, Id.Prt.310c

ἐγκυκλέομαι.definition: Pass., roll or rotate in the sockets, of; in com. sense, to be cooped up, Ar.V.699

ἐγγυθήκη.definition: stand for vessels, tripods, etc., Lys.Fr.34, Hegesand.45; cf

ἑξαήμερος.definition: of or in six days, the six days of creation, Ph.1.69: also Id.2.197

ἐξαρκής.definition: enough, sufficient, A.Pers.237 ; put in order, S.Tr.334

ἐκτράπελος.definition: turning from the common course; odious, prob. in Pi.P.1.92, 4.105

ἐπιθύτης.definition: one who burns incense, Gloss.; so prob. in CIG3663 A15

εὐηθίζομαι.definition: Med., to act like an play the fool, Pl.R.336c; to be merry, jest, Philostr.VA8.7

εὔκολος.definition: of persons, easily satisfied, contented with one's food, AP9.72 ; Plu.Lyc.16; Id.Galb.3: but, in earlier authors

ἐκκειμένως.definition: Adv. openly, to be open, frank, Philostr.VS2.17

ἐκχαλάω.definition: let go from, AP11.354.18; relax, Chor. in Rev.Phil.1.68

ἐπιπλαδάω.definition: to be loose, flabby on the surface, Ph.2.418 codd

εὔκραιρος.definition: of ships, with beautiful beak, Opp.H.2.516, Tryph.213

ἐπισπονδή.definition: in pl., treaty made after another, Th.5.32

ἐνζάω.definition: live in, f.l. in Ph.1.65: metaph., prob. in IGRom.4.146

εὐπρόσφορος.definition: easily uttering, fluent; easily assimilated, nutritious, of food, Xenocr.9

ἐπεντείνω.definition: stretch tight, stretched upon; intr., press on amain, Ar.Pax514 ; gain strength, increase, of a report, Thphr.Char.8.7

εἰλυφάω.definition: = foreg., Ep. part. Il.11.156, Hes.Th.692; intr., Nonn.D.30.81

ἔφιππος.definition: on horseback, riding, Eup.27; a rushing wave of horses, S.El.733

ἔμπλεκτος.definition: inwoven: ashlar filled up with rubble, Vitr.2.8.7

ἐφάπαξ.definition: Adv. once for all, Eup.175, Ep.Rom.6.10; at once, Ep.Cor.15.6

ἔμπροσθα.definition: Adv., Aeol. and Dor. for sq., Tab.Heracl.1.57, 101, A.D.Adv.153.17

ἐντομίς.definition: incision, gash, LXXLe.19.28, 21.5; grave, burial-vault, Ath.Mitt.16.368

ἐπιβρομέω.definition: roar upon or over, of the sea; c. acc. cogn., of lions, Opp.C.3.36; Nonn.D.6.115

ἐπιδίζημαι.definition: inquire besides, go on to inquire; seek for or demand besides, Id.5.106: so Mosch.2.28

ἔμφορτος.definition: laden with, Opp.H.2.212: abs., laden, D.L.1.31; Iamb.VP8.36

ἐχεδερμία.definition: being hide-bound, of horses, Hippiatr.26: = Lat. coriago, Veget.Mulom.2.118

ἐγχλοάω.definition: to be of a greenish hue, Nic.Th.154

ἐκκόπρωσις.definition: cleansing from excrement: emptying of the stomach by purging, Hp.Prog.15

εὐκόρυφος.definition: with handsome head, Herm. ap. Stob.1.49.45: metaph., of sentences, well wound up, ending well, D.H.Dem.40,43

ἔμβασις.definition: embarkation, Plb.4.10.3; place of; step, interpol. in Luc.Salt.10

ἐξαρμόζω.definition: in Pass., to be displaced, wrenched out, Philostr.Her.1.3; Id.Im.2.17; ib.4

ἐκτύπωσις.definition: modelling in relief, Aesar. ap; figure, J.AJ12.2.9

εὐυπόδητος.definition: of a sandal, easy to bind under the foot, Tz.ad Lyc.853

ἑνάενος.definition: of a year old, Thphr.HP8.11.5, Stud.Pal.1.62.33, al

ἐπιμύθιος.definition: coming after the fable: the moral, Luc.Bacch.8, Aphth.Prog.1, Herm.in Phdr.p.92A

ἐπαλωστής.definition: one who threshes with oxen, X.Oec.18.5

ἐπίμεσος.definition: middle, AB108; a middle verb, Gloss

ἐγκιλικίζω.definition: play the Cilician to one, i. e. cheat, Pherecr.166

ἐπείκτης.definition: one who urges or presses, EM356.34, Gloss.; coupled with Cod.Just.7.51.5.1

εὐπόριστος.definition: easy to procure or secure; Act., providing one's subsistence with ease, Ptol.Tetr.155

ἐπιδεξιότης.definition: handiness, cleverness, tact; position on the right, Paul.Al.E.3

ἐκθερμαίνω.definition: strengthd. for warm thoroughly; cause to evaporate by heat, Arist.Pr.870a17 : metaph., Plu.2.48c

ἐπιπρό.definition: Adv. right through, onwards, A.R.2.133, D.P.276

ἐκτρέχω.definition: fut. Diph.19.3: pf; run off or away, Ar.Av.991

ἐπιχύνω.definition: late form for Herm. ap. Stob.1.49.69, JHS19.73 , etc

εἰστοξεύω.definition: shoot arrows at, Hdt.9.49; shoot papers attached to arrows into.., D.C.48.25

εὐκίων.definition: gen. with beautiful pillars, E.Ion185 , cf. AP7.648.7

ἐνόμνυμαι.definition: Med., make an affidavit, PHal.1.71 : —Pass., sworn depositions, ib.77. .)

εὐψυχία.definition: good courage, high spirit, A.Pers.326, E.Med.403, Th.1.121, etc.; goodness of soul, opp. Pl.Lg.791c

ἔμμονος.definition: abiding, lasting; of disease, chronic, LXXLe.13.51; ib.Si.30.17

ἐπορθρισμός.definition: rising early, morning cries of noisy tax-gatherers, Plu.2.654f

ἐρίθακος.definition: robin-redbreast, Erithacus rubecula, Arist.HA592b22, Gp.15.1.22, etc.; cf. bird described as imitative by Porph.Abst.3.4 must be different

εὐκηλήτειρα.definition: she that lulls or soothes, Hes.Op.464

ἔγκνισμα.definition: a piece of meat, Argive word in Plu.2.296f

εἰσκαθοράω.definition: look down upon, , Bgk. for Anacr.1.6

ἐπίστροφος.definition: having dealings with, conversant; Adv. diligently, exactly, Ephipp.3.10, Memn.7.3

ἐντύπωμα.definition: that which is graved, of a pier, Agatharch.92

ἐκμεθύσκω.definition: make quite drunk: metaph., .. over-charge them with moisture, Thphr.CP5.15.3; AP5.3

ἐφόδιος.definition: for a journey, EM348.43; on the road, accessible, BGU1116.8

ἐκβράζω.definition: throw off humours, Hp.Mul.2.113; —Pass., gush out, Id.Gland.4; —Med., Id.Int.1

ἐμβολεύς.definition: anything put in: piston; model for metal fittings or stone- work, Ph.Bel.70.13, HeroBel.96.5

εὐμελιτέω.definition: to have a good stock of honey, Arist.HA625a24, Thphr.HP6.2.3

ἐφίδρυσις.definition: planting firmly, in pl., of the feet, Ph.1.125

ἐξήχησις.definition: unpleasant sound, Ael.Dion.Fr.298; mode of utterance, PMag. Par.1.923

ἕλκυσις.definition: attraction, Aret.SD1.10; drawing, in cupping, Hp.Loc.Hom.22

ἐξεράω.definition: aor. :—Pass., aor.1 part; disgorge, Crates Com.14.8; = Pherecr.131.1

ἐμβρονταῖος.definition: struck by lightning: place struck by lightning, Lat. bidental, D.S.8.9

εὐεργετέω.definition: the augm. is sts. found, esp. in; to be proclaimed as I.2, JHS10.76

ἐκπλήρωσις.definition: filling up, Apollon.Cit.I; fulfilment of a cosmic cycle, Cat.Cod. Astr.1.163

ἐπεισφορέω.definition: = in Pass., ib.468; Med., abs., take food afterwards, Archig. ap. Orib.8.1.7

ἐκμύσσομαι.definition: Med., blow the nose, read by Gal. for in Hp.Nat. Hom.7

ἐπιχειμάζω.definition: pass the winter at a place or in an; impers., it is stormy at the same time, c. dat., Gem.Calend.5:—Pass., ibid

ἐφεδράζω.definition: pf. part. set or rest upon; support, Id.7.8:—Pass., Sor.1.70

ἑτερόχρονος.definition: of different times: a change of tense, as a figure of speech, Phoeb.Fig.1.5

εὐγωνία.definition: regularity of angles, prob. cj. in E.Ion1137

ἐξαγώγιμος.definition: unsettled, migratory, of people, v.l. for E.Fr.360.10; for drawing off water, D.H.4.44

ἐαρίζω.definition: pass the spring, X.An.3.5.15; bloom as in spring, Ph.2.99:—Med., Pl.Ax.371c

ἐρινεός.definition: wild fig-tree, Ficus Caprificus; = Arist.HA557b25, Dsc.1.128

ἔγχυμα.definition: instillation, Gal.12.649; filling, content, of a vessel, Hp.Cord.8, Gal.11.260,7.524

ἔνσοφος.definition: wise in a thing, Man.4.549: abs., IG14.1020

ἐνοιδέω.definition: swell up in, Hp.Hum.8 vulg., Antyll. ap. Orib.7.16.6: metaph. of the wounds of love, Plu.Fr.25.4

εἰσφρέω.definition: swallow, Arist.Mir.831b11; intr, let oneself in, enter, Plb. l.c., Alciphr.3.53, Jul.Caes.315a

ἐπιμίξ.definition: Ep. Adv. mixedly, confusedly, pell-mell, Il.11.525, cf. 21.16; Ares rages without respect of persons, Od.11.537; Il.14.60: in later Prose, LXXWi.14.25

ἑξάκλινος.definition: with six couches, also EM346.14:—as Subst. couch to hold six, Mart.9.59.9

ἐνιαχῆ.definition: Adv., in some places, c. gen; sometimes, Plu.2.427f, Ath.11.478b

ἐγκαίω.definition: aor. 1 part. IG12.374.96, but; brand, Luc.Pisc.46:—Pass., Arr.An.5.3.4

ἐμπρόσωπος.definition: before the face of, in the presence of, c. dat., Phalar.Ep.147

ἐκλιπαίνω.definition: in fut. make smooth as oil, Posidipp. ap.Ath.7.318d:—Pass., to be enriched, fertilized, Plu.Mar.21

ἐνδινέω.definition: roll, Hp.Epid.5.99, cf; revolve, go about, Dor. for Theoc.15.82

εὔσχετος.definition: easily kept in its place, Hp.Off.15

ἐκλιπής.definition: failing, deficient; omitted, overlooked, Th.1.97, Arr.An.1.12.2

ἐρέβινθος.definition: chick-pea, Cicer arietinum; metaph., of the membrum virile, Ar.Ach.801, Ra.545 ; cf. IV

εὔριπος.definition: any strait or narrow sea, where the flux; generally, canal, ditch, etc., SIG799.7 , Babr.120.2, AP14.135.2 , D.H.3.68

ἐπιβωμίτης.definition: one who attends the altar, a sacrificing priest, Lysim. ap. J.Ap.1.34

ἑσμοφύλαξ.definition: watcher of a swarm of bees, Gp.15.2.9

ἐκποκίζω.definition: Att. fut. pull out wool or hair, Ar.Th.567

ἐπιδορπίς.definition: old name for Philem. ap. Ath.1.11d

ἐξοσιόω.definition: dedicate, devote, Plu.Cam.20, prob. in; Med., avert by expiation, D.S.15.9 , Plu.2.586f

ἔμπονος.definition: patient of labour, Hp.Aër.12; toilsome, painful, Aret.SA1.9; vehement outcry, LXX3 Ma.1.28

ἑρμηνεία.definition: interpretation, explanation; in Music, expression, Plu.2.1138a, 1144d

ἐξαλγέω.definition: c. acc., suffer pain in, Ps.-Callisth.3.27

ἐξάρτυσις.definition: equipment, esp. of musical arrangement, Callicrat. ap. Stob.4.28.16, Eurypham.ib.39.27; of the soul, Iamb.VP15.64 , 25.114

ἐγκάνθιος.definition: in or of the inner angle of the eye, Dsc.Eup.1.8, Gal.19.437

ἐναντίωμα.definition: anything opposite or opposed; incompatibility, Pl.R.524e: pl., conflicting impulses, ib.603d; differences, discrepancies, Arist.PA695a18

ἐπακανθίζω.definition: in pres. part., pointed, Thphr.HP3.10.1,al.; thorny, set with thorns, ib.4.8.8, 6.4.1, al

ἐξεπαίρω.definition: stir up, excite one to do, c. inf., Ar.Lys.623; E.Fr.963

ἐπιστροφεύς.definition: turning on a pivot, a name for; one who causes to return to its source, Dam.Pr.270

εἰρεσιώνη.definition: branch of olive or laurel wound; the song itself, Hom.Epigr.15, Plu.Thes.22

ἑτερόζηλος.definition: zealous for one side. Adv; zealous in another pursuit, AP11.216

εἰκοσίπεδος.definition: twenty feet wide or long, in Dor. form Tab.Heracl.1.62, al

ἐμβόλιον.definition: missile discharged, javelin, D.S.1.35; interlude, episode, Cic.QF3.1.7

ἐπικάρπιος.definition: I) bringer or guardian of; pedicle or fruit-stalk, Phanias ap.Ath.2.68c, cf. 51c

ἔκποθεν.definition: Adv. from some place or other, A.R.2.224, 824; Q.S.3.437: Id.9.420, 14.74

ἐξοικέω.definition: emigrate, remove, Lys.31.9; Pass., to be completely inhabited, Th.2.17

ἐπαφαιρέω.definition: take away again, esp. blood, Aret.CA2.10, Gal.6.299

ἐριώπης.definition: fem. large-eyed, full-eyed, in fem., Hom.Epigr.1.2: fem. acc. Max.545 ; Id.32

ἐχινομήτρα.definition: the largest kind of sea-urchin, Echinus melo, Arist.HA530b6

ἐκτελειόω.definition: or bring to perfection, Thphr.CP4.1.5, etc.; Plu.Publ.23

εἰσαρτίζω.definition: join or fit into, Hp.Morb.2.33 vulg

εὔτοκος.definition: bringing forth easily, Arist.HA576a22; = I , Ph.1.274; fertile, Hp.Nat.Mul.16

ἐκβιβάζω.definition: Att. fut. causal of make to; in athletic contests, eliminate, i.e. win heats, IGRom.3.626 , al.; SIG728 H

ἐκβλύζω.definition: gush out, Orph.L.490; LXXPr.3.10; trans., cause to gush out, Orph.Fr.255; Plu.TG13

εὐείλητος.definition: well rolled up, tight, gloss on Eust.1056.65

ἐριβῶλαξ.definition: with large clods, of rich, loamy soil: hence, very fertile, once in Od., 13.235; freq. in Il., 1.155, etc. ; Orph.L.655; Cratin.56

ἐριβόας.definition: loud-shouting, of Bacchus, Pi.Fr.75.10; of Hermes, AP15.27.5

εὐχρωτέω.definition: imper. in an epitaph, = etc., IG14.2305

ἑκτέος.definition: to be held, Ar.Ach.259; one must have, X.Mem.3.11.2; Aen.Tact.Praef.3; = Pl.Grg.490c

εὐθάλεια.definition: bloom, flower of a thing, Archyt. ap. Stob.3.1.107: EM442.13

ἔλλαμψις.definition: shining, flashing, Placit.3.3.12; radiation of heat, Steph.in Hp.1.134D,al

εὐμοιρέω.definition: to be well off for, c. gen., Hp.Ep.27, Phalar.Ep.53 , Anon.Fig.p.156 S.; in Epitaphs, IG14.2387, etc

ἐπωμίδιος.definition: on the shoulder, Hp.Oss.12; Subst. Dim. of horse's trappings, App.Mith.115

ἑξάμιτος.definition: of six strands, prob. in AP7.702

ἐνσταλόω.definition: Dor. for set upon a pillar, IGRom.1.1295

ἐκθέω.definition: run out; make a sally, Ar.Lys.456; X.HG3.1.7; of javelins, fly out, Plu.Marc.16; rush, hurry out, Arist.EN1149a28

ἐπιγύαλος.definition: hollow on the surface, dub.l.in S.OC1492

ἐπιγνωρίζω.definition: make known, announce, signify; recognize, J.AJ19.3.1

ἐπωπεύς.definition: inspector, dub. in Agatharch.26; a divinity , Schwyzer720.24

ἑξάεδρος.definition: with six surfaces, Theol.Ar.25; Subst. hexahedron, Gal.5.669

ἐπιγηθέω.definition: rejoice, triumph over, A.Pr.157; exult in, Opp.H.1.570:— also in form Simp.in Epict.p.88D

ἐπίλυτρος.definition: set at liberty for ransom, Str.11.2.12

ἐκφράζω.definition: tell over, recount, A.Pr.950, dub. l. in; describe, Hermog.Prog.10, Id.2.4, Men.Rh.p.373 S.:—Pass., TheonProg.2

ἔξωρος.definition: untimely, out of season, unfitting; too late, too old, superannuated, Aeschin.1.95, Plu.Sull.36, Luc.Herm.78, al. : c. gen., too old for . ., Luc.Merc.Cond.7. Adv. Philostr.VS1.21.8

ἑξήρετμος.definition: of six banks of oars, i.e. in command of a Epigr.Gr.337

ἐξίχνευσις.definition: tracking out, Gp.2.6.22; reduction of copper ore, Syn.Alch.p.66B

ἐκλήπτωρ.definition: later contractor of; tax-collector, Just.Nov.130.3, al

ἑξάτονος.definition: in or of six tones, Plu.2.1028e, Aristid.Quint.1.9, Alex.Eph. ap. Theo Sm.p.141 H

ἐπεθίζομαι.definition: to be accustomed to a thing, Aristox.Harm.p.33 M

ἐπήριστος.definition: or contended for, coined by Eust.725.16, 1962.7, to expl

ἐναρμογή.definition: fitting of a surgical tube, Antyll. ap. Orib.10.19.4

ἐκφλέγω.definition: to set on fire: metaph., Ar.Pax608; warm up, Aret.SA2.1

ἐπίσκοτος.definition: in the dark, darkened, of the sun, prob. in Pi.Pae.9.5, dub.l.in Plu.Aem.17

ἐπιφώνησις.definition: acclamation, cry, Plu.Pomp.4; added remark, Ps.-Plu.Vit.Hom.65

ἐπιτάσσω.definition: Att. put upon one as a duty; use the imperative mood, .. .. Arist.Po.1456b16; opp. IG12.76.33

ἐμφύσημα.definition: an inflation of the stomach, peritoncum, or cellular tissue, mostly of the stomach, Gal.19.132; swelling of the eye, Dem.Ophth. ap. Aët.7.14; of the knee, Gal.12.203

ἐπικυκλέω.definition: intr., come round in turn upon, S.Tr.130:—Pass., D.H.Rh.10.17

ἐσχατίζω.definition: to be last, to come too late, LXX1 Ma.5.53: c. inf., ib.Jd.5.28 cod.A

ἐπιξύω.definition: grate over, Pl.R.406a, cf; skim over, Arat.650

ἐπιθάπτω.definition: bury again, Philostr.Her.1.3; bury another in the same grave, CIG4341d , 4366k , sqq

ἐνθνήσκω.definition: of the hand, grow rigid or torpid in, Id.Hec.246.—Dub. in Prose, Lys.16.15 , Plu.2.357d

ἔμμισθος.definition: in receipt of pay, hired, Th.6.22; of work, paid, Pl.Lg.920e

ἐπακριβής.definition: accurate: neut. as Adv., Aps.Rh.p.316 H

ἐπισκυθίζω.definition: pour out drink in Scythian fashion, i.e. with unmixed wine, Hdt.6.84, Chamael. ap. Ath.10.427c

ἑστιάω.definition: Ion. and Dor. impf. Lys.19.27; abs., give a feast, ib.12.51; entertainers, Pl.Grg.518d; Epich.35.4

ἐμβαρύθω.definition: to be heavy upon, Nic.Th.324; of smell, to be offensive, Id.Th.512

εὐνόητος.definition: easily understood, Iamb.Protr.21; intelligent, Vett. Val.45.28

ἐπισκευή.definition: repair, restoration, Hdt.2.174; means of repairing, Th.1.52

ἐναιωρέομαι.definition: float or drift about in; containing suspended matter, Id.Prorrh.1.4

εὐσυνάγωγος.definition: easily collected together, a place convenient for collecting imports, Arist.Pol.1331b2

εὐθετίζω.definition: set in order, arrange orderly, Hes.Th.541; in Pass., to be suitably employed, A.D.Adv.140.11, Synt.169.19

ἑτεροιόω.definition: make of different kind, alter, Hp.Acut.37; Pass., to be differentiated, Dam.Pr.220

ἐπίπεμπτος.definition: Math., = 1+1/5, Nicom.Ar.1.22, etc; of loans bearing interest at the rate of 1/5 of the principal, i.e.20 per cent., X.Vect.3.9

εὐγραμμία.definition: good design, of figures in tapestry, Callix.2

ἐπικόλλημα.definition: that which is glued on, tessellated work, Id.HP4.3.4

ἐμπολή.definition: Arc. IG5.3.27 (pl., Tegea, iv; gain made by traffic, profit, , cf. Palaeph.45; esp. harlot's hire, Artem.1.78 , D.C.79.13

ἐπινήχομαι.definition: swim to or over to, c. acc., Call.Del.21; swim against, attack, Opp.H.2.46

ἐπιστάζω.definition: let fall in drops upon or into, instil; intr., bleed at the nose again, Hp.Prorrh.1.148, Coac.337

ἔκθερμος.definition: very hot, Vett.Val.162.23, Gal.4.490, Aspasia ap. Aët.16.22

ἐγκραυγάζω.definition: shout at a person, Phld.Lib.p.5 O

ἐκβυθίζομαι.definition: Pass., come forth from the deep, v.l. in Callistr.Stat.14

ἐπακοντίζω.definition: dart a thing at a person, Socr.Ep.30.13 codd

ἐπιζητέω.definition: seek after, wish for, miss, Hdt.3.36; request, Anatolian Studies 38, cf. PMasp.156.16

ἐξατονέω.definition: to be tired out, Arist.HA630b8; to be weakened, Ph.2.672

εὔφημος.definition: Dor. uttering sounds of; abstaining from inauspicious words, i.e. religiously silent, . . A.Ag.1247; Id.Ch.581; so perh. Id.Fr.40; moving the lips of reverent thought, i.e. keeping a holy silence, S.OC132 ; so i.e. in…

ἑκατέρωσε.definition: Adv. to either side, either way; both ways, Id.Phd.112e; Id.R.619a

εὔασμα.definition: a Bacchanalian shout, in pl., E.Ba.129,151

ἐρινός.definition: = wild fig-tree, Stratt.42; = a wild fig, S.Fr.181; Nic.Al.319

ἐπαξονέω.definition: place on axles, Orph.Fr.49.39; enroll in tablets, register, LXXNu.1.18

ἐλάτη.definition: silver fir, Abies cephalonica; oar, as made of pine-wood, Od.12.172, cf. Il.7.5; later, ship or boat, E.Ph.208 , Alc.444

εὐπάτωρ.definition: = foreg., A.Pers.970; a good father, dub. in Man.4.86

ἐνωπαδίως.definition: Adv., in one's face, to one's face, Od.23.94

εὐκλεής.definition: acc.sg. contr. Pi.P.12.24; Orphic title of Hades, IG14.641

ἐπιβήτωρ.definition: one who mounts, Od.18.263; of male animals, e.g.a boar, Od.11.131; of a bull, Theoc.25.128

ἐκθεάομαι.definition: see out, see to the end, S.OT1253; Pass., to be made visible, prob. for in Ph.1.96

ἑτεράριθμος.definition: of different number: change of number, as a figure of speech, Phoeb.Fig.1.5

εὐίδρως.definition: easily perspiring, Thphr.Sud.20: but neut. ib.19:—also Gal.6.222: pl. Arist.Pr.867b35

ἐπιχαυνόω.definition: relax, Phlp.in Ph.201.30:—Pass., metaph., to be elated at

ἔγκτημα.definition: land held in a country by a person not belonging to it, And.3.15, D.7.42, IG22.43.27, App.Mith.47

ἐπίχυσις.definition: pouring upon or in; = Phlp.in de An.291.32

εἰσόπιν.definition: Adv. back: c. gen., hereafter, A.Supp.617

εὐθυπορία.definition: straightness of course, Pl.Lg.747a; straightness of grain in wood, Thphr.HP5.6.2

ἐκκόλαψις.definition: breaking the shell, of a chick, Arist.HA561b29

ἐμβυθίζω.definition: cause to sink to the bottom, Plu.2.981a

ἐλαιοκονία.definition: plaster made from lime and oil, Eust.382.37, Steph.in Hp.2.384D

ἐφημερία.definition: division of the priests for the daily; the service itself, LXX1 Es.1.16

ἐπιμερίζω.definition: impart, give a portion, v.l. in LXXJb.31.2; Astrol., assign a number of years to life, Vett. Val.164.9

ἐξοιδέω.definition: swell or be swollen up, . . E.Cyc.227; Luc.DMort.14.5, cf. Aristid.Or.24.44: metaph., swell beyond its proper size, of a body in the state, Plb.6.18.7

ἐναγείρω.definition: gather together in or with, Nic.Th.945 :—Med., A.R.3.347: Ep.aor. part. Pass. Opp.H.2.351

ἑτερόπορπος.definition: clasped on one side, of a woman's dress, Call.Fr.225

ἐπίφλεξις.definition: application of heat, opp. caustics, Paul.Aeg.4.5

ἐξινιάζω.definition: take out the fibres from, Peripl.M.Rubr.65:—Pass., Ath.9.406a

ἐντροχάζω.definition: = intervene, occur; exercise a horse in a ring, Hippiatr.33

ἐπαρτίζω.definition: get ready, in Ep. aor; intr., fit in, Hp.Morb.2.33

ἐνωραΐζομαι.definition: beautify oneself for the benefit of; give oneself airs in, Agath.2.26

ἐμβοάω.definition: call upon, shout to, X.Cyn.6.17; D.H.11.38, etc.: abs., shout aloud, Th.2.92, 4.34; Diog.Oen.25

ἐφίστασις.definition: incorrect form for II.5, in pl., Erot. s.v

ἐπεισόδιος.definition: coming in besides, adventitious; addition for the purpose of giving pleasure, Plu.2.629c, 710d; of dessert, AP6.232.6 )

ἐξαρτάω.definition: hang upon, Plb.18.18.4; stretch out, Ael.NA4.21

εὐρύπεδος.definition: with broad surface, spacious, Lyr.Adesp.138.3, AP7.748

ἑξάχρονος.definition: of six times, Heph.3.2, cf. Procl.in Prm.p.990S

ἐπισυμμαχία.definition: alliance against a common enemy, Philipp. ap. D.12.7 codd

εὐηχής.definition: Dor. well-sounding, tuneful, Pi.P.2.14; Call.Del.296; Plu.2.437d; euphonious, Phld.Po.2.3

ἐνσόριον.definition: place for a sarcophagus, IGRom.4.1452 , AJA18.68 , etc

ἐκθνήσκω.definition: fut. aor. —die away; to be in a death-like swoon, Hp.Epid.5.42, cf. Philem.1.6 D.; opp. Pl.Lg.959a; opp. Arist.HA521a11, cf.Pr.962b4:—so in S.Tr.568 may retain its usual sense, fainting away, at the point of death

ἐπιπροιάλλω.definition: poet. Verb, set out or place before; send on one after another, h.Cer.326; Q.S.6.231

ἐπιπροίημι.definition: poet. Verb, send forth, . . on board ship to Ilium, Il.18.58; but . . . . to the ships, to go . . , 17.708; sent them forth to supplicate, 9.520; shoot an arrow at him, 4.94; A.R.4.1185; Nic.Th.778; Orac. ap. Luc.Alex…

ἐρέικω.definition: bruise, pound, of pulse, Ar.Fr.22, cf. Dieuch. ap. Orib.4.6.4; Hp.Morb.2.67, Mul.2.113, Superf.34; Id.Nat.Mul.103; Arist.HA595b7; Diocl.Fr.140; shattered them, A.Ag.655; of pain, S.Fr.152

ἐν.definition: + dat.: in, dentro, fra, presso (stato in luogo)

εἰς.definition: + acc.: in, verso, contro, fino a (moto a luogo); per (fine)

ἐκ.definition: + gen.: da, fuori da (moto da luogo); a partire da, in conseguenza di (ἐξ davanti a vocale)

ἐξ.definition: + gen.: da, fuori da — forma di ἐκ davanti a vocale

ἐπί.definition: + gen.: sopra, al tempo di; + dat.: su, presso, a condizione di, per; + acc.: verso, contro, per (estensione)

ἕ.definition: sé, lui/lei (acc. del riflessivo di 3ª pers.; gen. οὗ, dat. οἷ; spesso enclitico ἑ)

ἕνεκα.definition: + gen. (di norma posposta): a causa di, per, in favore di (anche ἕνεκεν, εἵνεκα)

εἶδον.definition: vidi: aor. II (tema ϝιδ-, cfr. lat. video) usato come aoristo di ὁράω; ind. εἶδον, cong. ἴδω, ott. ἴδοιμι, imv. ἰδέ, inf. ἰδεῖν, ptc. ἰδών; med. εἰδόμην (apparvi)

εἶπον.definition: dissi: aor. II usato come aoristo di λέγω/φημί (tema ϝεπ-); inf. εἰπεῖν, ptc. εἰπών; alternativo aor. I εἶπα

εἰσείδω.definition: εἰσεῖδον: scorsi, guardai dentro/verso — aor. II di εἰσοράω

ἔοικα.definition: sembro, sono simile a (+ dat.): pf. con valore di presente (tema ϝεικ-/ϝοικ-); ptc. ἐοικώς/εἰκώς; impers. ἔοικε: sembra, conviene; ὡς ἔοικε: a quanto pare

ἐμμεμαώς.definition: impetuoso, bramoso [epico]: ptc. pf. di ἐμμέμαα (μέμαα rafforzato)

ἐμπίπλημι.definition: riempire (+ gen. della cosa): fut. ἐμπλήσω, aor. ἐνέπλησα, pf. m.-p. ἐμπέπλησμαι; cfr. πίμπλημι

εἴδομαι.definition: apparire, sembrare; assomigliare a (+ dat.) [epico]: medio del tema ϝιδ- (cfr. εἶδον)
